name: Eliana: Your Personal Demon
source:
You wake up one morning, irritated at that fact, as always. Suddenly, a strange creature appears before you, ready to reap your soul and drag you to hell. And yet, she takes pity on you.

[from [url=https://hellcatstudios.itch.io/elianaypd]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天清晨，你醒了过来，一如既往地为自己还会醒来而烦躁。突然，一个奇怪的生物出现在眼前，准备收走你的灵魂，将你拖入地狱。然而，她却怜悯起了你。

[摘自[url=https://hellcatstudios.itch.io/elianaypd]itch.io[/url]]
